name: armors
description: Every armor type and rarity combination

fields.name: Common light armor
fields.description: Ordinary clothing or light padding that offers mobility but no meaningful AR.

fields.name: Uncommon light armor
fields.description: Well-fitted reinforced clothing offering modest protection.

fields.name: Rare light armor
fields.description: Superior flexible armor made from unusually resilient material.

fields.name: Epic light armor
fields.description: Remarkable weightless protection crafted through rare techniques.

fields.name: Legendary light armor
fields.description: A unique second skin offering exceptional protection without restricting movement.

fields.name: Common medium armor
fields.description: Standard reinforced leather, scale, or partial mail.

fields.name: Uncommon medium armor
fields.description: Reliable professional armor balancing protection and mobility.

fields.name: Rare medium armor
fields.description: Master-crafted layered armor with excellent coverage.

fields.name: Epic medium armor
fields.description: Exceptional armor reinforced by magical materials or runes.

fields.name: Legendary medium armor
fields.description: A celebrated suit offering extraordinary protection without becoming cumbersome.

fields.name: Common heavy armor
fields.description: A basic full suit of plate or similarly massive protection.

fields.name: Uncommon heavy armor
fields.description: A carefully fitted heavy suit with reinforced joints.

fields.name: Rare heavy armor
fields.description: Masterwork heavy armor built from superior metal or monster plates.

fields.name: Epic heavy armor
fields.description: A formidable runic suit capable of withstanding extraordinary punishment.

fields.name: Legendary heavy armor
fields.description: A unique fortress-like suit remembered in songs and military histories.
